changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE club_records ADD CONSTRAINT ck_club_uefa_coefficient CHECK (CASE WHEN uefa_coefficient_hex IS NOT NULL AND uefa_rule_version IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(uefa_coefficient_hex)=152 AND uefa_rule_version BETWEEN 0 AND 65535 AND kind='CLUB' ELSE uefa_coefficient_hex IS NULL AND uefa_rule_version IS NULL END)

rollback.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_records WHERE uefa_coefficient_hex IS NOT NULL OR uefa_rule_version IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
ALTER TABLE club_records DROP CONSTRAINT ck_club_uefa_coefficient
